scenarios.title: Opening the shipped sample workspace
scenarios.intent: A new user opens the workspace we ship. Everything they see on day one is what this scenario measures.

steps.label: The shipped workspace parses without issues
steps.expectation: all sample models load with zero parse issues — this is the first thing a new user sees

steps.label: Every shipped sample passes document hygiene with no errors
steps.expectation: zero hygiene errors across the eleven samples

steps.label: Every citation in the shipped workspace resolves
steps.expectation: a new user opening the sample sees no broken provenance

steps.label: The shipped workspace contains the sources its models cite
steps.expectation: source traceability is the headline capability — the demo must demonstrate it

steps.label: The shipped workspace contains the compiled console artifact its manifest declares
steps.expectation: workspace_NN.md registers `## NN Artifacts: Workspace Hub Dashboard`; the file should exist

steps.label: A field named `source` that is declared as a content path is not treated as a citation
steps.expectation: the Citation vocabulary should key on the declared field TYPE, not on the field NAME
